title: Rav Shmuel bar Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Menachot 32a, and the Gemara brings proof from him for the words of Rava.
He is also mentioned in Nedarim, chapter 3, halakhah 2, and Shevuot, chapter 3, halakhah 9, where it is related that he saw a snake so large that it covered the royal wagon.
He is also mentioned in the Zohar, Chayei Sarah 124a, in the Midrash HaNe'elam.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Menachot 32a follows Hyman’s לב. locator. The chapter/halakhah form of Nedarim 3:2 and Shevuot 3:9 points to the Jerusalem Talmud; references follow Hyman.
Hyman prints קכד., rendered 124a. The Zohar edition is unspecified; the reference is to Midrash HaNe’elam within Chayei Sarah.
